name: ecommerce-intel-pp-cli
description: Private local-first ecommerce intelligence CLI for Shopify, Klaviyo, GA4, GSC, Ahrefs, revenue opportunities, inventory risk, and GEO/answer-engine readiness.

novel_features.name: Unified ecommerce live sync
novel_features.description: sync imports local fixture/JSON or shells out to Shopify, Klaviyo, GA4, GSC, and Ahrefs child CLIs and merges their --agent output

novel_features.name: Money products
novel_features.description: ranks products by revenue and margin with inventory and SEO context

novel_features.name: Opportunity queue
novel_features.description: prioritizes revenue, inventory, email, category, product, and GEO actions

novel_features.name: GEO audit
novel_features.description: assesses llms.txt, structured data, product facts, buying guides, and ChatGPT/Perplexity/AI Overviews readiness

novel_features.name: Inventory risk
novel_features.description: flags stockouts and low days-of-stock that threaten revenue

novel_features.name: Source coverage
novel_features.description: audits product, page, category, and email-flow evidence across Shopify, Klaviyo, GA4, GSC, and Ahrefs

novel_features.name: Merchandising link plan
novel_features.description: recommends collection-to-PDP and PDP-to-PDP internal links by category, revenue, and link equity

novel_features.name: Experiment plan
novel_features.description: turns a product into PDP offer, schema, content, and measurement experiments

novel_features.name: Forecast impact
novel_features.description: estimates revenue upside from conversion, CTR, and inventory gaps

novel_features.name: Restock winners
novel_features.description: prioritizes high-margin, high-velocity products before stockout or decay

novel_features.name: Cannibalization
novel_features.description: detects products competing for the same query/category and recommends a canonical product

novel_features.name: Category clusters
novel_features.description: aggregates revenue, sessions, clicks, backlinks, and decay by collection

novel_features.name: Weekly digest
novel_features.description: produces a compact weekly ecommerce summary
